frozen.checkpoint_selection: final fixed budget; no held-out tuning or early stopping
frozen.support_intervention: append disjoint training groups at lengths 6..8; identical optimizer-update budget, NOT identical token/FLOP budget
frozen.eos_probe: suppress EOS before record target length; task-aware diagnostic policy, not the original model's unconstrained generation
frozen.position_probe: shift fixed sinusoidal position signals by +4 at inference; input perturbation, not retraining a different positional architecture

limits: EOS suppression uses task length and changes inference policy; it is diagnostic, not an unconstrained capability score
position shift tests sensitivity only; it cannot establish which positional architecture would generalize after training
support comparison holds optimizer updates fixed; token consumption and padded compute change; do not attribute all differences solely to length coverage
test 9..10 remains outside both training supports; all seeds and outcomes are retained
